**FIXED #291 (commit 0b9ac5c): cold-boot fetches head+base full-history — RED→GREEN COLDBOOT-DEPTH test; fresh review FIX SOUND; PR gated on human status:approved**

**FIXED** on branch `fix/issue-291-coldboot-fetch-base` (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-291, off origin/issue-266), commit **0b9ac5c**, **38 counted**, 1709/1709 tests, repo:check clean.

**Fix**: `cold-boot.mjs` `defaultCloneDetached` now fetches BOTH prView shas (head + baseRefOid) with FULL history (dropped `--depth 1`); `gatherColdBoot` passes `baseSha: prView.baseRefOid ?? null`. Also clears stale worktree dir (prune + rmSync) to kill the "is not a working tree" noise. Full-history-both per reviewer ruling (implementation detail below ADR level).

**Test (strict TDD, RED observed)**: COLDBOOT-DEPTH — REAL default (no injected fetch), local bare remote with diverged base/head off a common ancestor; asserts `git diff base...head` resolves AND `git checkout <base> -- <file>` reverts to base content (§10.4). Plus a baseSha-propagation unit test. Existing `{ sha }` assertion updated to `{ sha, baseSha: null }`.

**Durable record** (reviewer-requested, plainfiles): rec-9c52ca412ebb0f97 — "seams tested ≠ defaults tested: every DI seam's real default needs a real-fixture test" (2nd instance: COLDBOOT-CWD → COLDBOOT-DEPTH). Added via `MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles node brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs save ... --type decision`.

**Fresh review: FIX SOUND** — independently reproduced RED→GREEN; all 7 checks pass. 2 non-blocking NITS: (N1) base lands in FETCH_HEAD then head overwrites it → base is a present-but-unreferenced object (only `gc --prune=now` mid-run drops it; default gc keeps 2wk — cosmetic); (N2) `git worktree prune` is whole-repo scope (pathological edge). CI uses fetch-depth:0 so no shallow-clone risk.

**BLOCKED on**: human `status:approved` on issue #291 (reviewer condition — issue-first gate) before the fix PR opens. Sequencing: fix merges to tracker BEFORE the #290 A/B reviewer runs (#290 head will move, correctly staling nothing). See [[sdd/issue-266-h1-brain-review/h1-5b-split]].
